context.test_setup: Write a TypeScript fixture with an exported helper and configure [tool.skylos] to ignore SKY-E004. Analyze the fixture and read the unused_exports list.
context.buggy_behavior: The report builder appended TypeScript export findings without consulting the project ignore list. The test still saw a SKY-E004 finding for helper.
context.fix: Pass the project configuration to the TypeScript export reporting step and filter findings whose rule ID is in the ignore list.
context.assertion: The unused_exports list is empty after applying the ignore setting.

cases.title: Keep methods used through dynamic dispatch

context.test_setup: Build a channel fixture whose action table stores method names as strings and calls them through getattr. Include an unrelated method named _stale as a control.
context.buggy_behavior: The analyzer failed to connect the names in the action table to the methods on the channel instance. It reported _cli_read and _api_read as unused.
context.fix: Track method names built in the channel and resolve those names against the receiver when the code dispatches with getattr.
context.assertion: _cli_read and _api_read are absent from unused methods, while _stale is still reported.
